card.name: Linking words in dose titration limits
card.fires_on: Small linking words, such as to, until, then, of, or a comma, in dose-adjustment instructions. They come right before the target or maximum dose, or before the level a lab value should return to.

modes.label: Titration to a goal
modes.description: Linking word after increase or titrate wording, just before the target or maximum dose or effect.
modes.example: The dosage can be increased to a maximum dose of 100 mg once daily as needed<< to>> control blood pressure [

modes.label: Withhold until recovery
modes.description: The word to or until after withhold or recovery, just before the baseline or grade level to reach.
modes.example: withhold bosutinib tablets until recovery<< to>> less than or equal to 2.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or digit inside a dose number or maximum figure.
